title: Seagrove "Sarayu" 187 San Roy Rd
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Beachfront with private beach access- 2 beach chair setups include 4 chairs and 2 umbrellas (Available Mar 1-Oct 31)- Private heated pool and sitting spa **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $85 per day**- Complimentary Peloton Bike- an Alaya exclusive amenity- Restoration Hardware furnishings- Gulf views from every room- 8 adult bikes- 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Vacation in Gulf-front luxury at Sarayu! Accommodating 26 guests in elegant comfort, this 7-bedroom, 7.5-bathroom Seagrove Beach home is perfect for groups and multiple families looking for days of quintessential coastal fun. Fall in love with the sprawling Gulf views, private pool, and easy beach access—mere steps out the back door!A classic white exterior with modern black-frame windows welcomes guests to this timeless beach abode. The ground level features a convenient outdoor shower for rinsing off after trips to the beach.The second level is the star of the home, boasting a generous great room for gathering in comfort and style. Whitewashed shiplap details and classic, natural decor curate a lavish coastal environment, while picture and transom windows offer a cascade of natural light and endless Gulf views. Enjoy sunlit brunches crafted in the chef’s kitchen, complete with quartzite countertops, a massive island, and premier appliances—including a beverage cooler and 2 dishwashers for efficient cleanup. The oversized wooden dining table and breakfast bar collectively host 16 guests for meals. When it’s time to unwind, adjourn to the living space and intimate seating area for conversation or to watch TV. Outside, drink in unbroken views of the shimmering Gulf from the pool, sunbathe on the loungers, sink into the peaceful sitting spa, or sip drinks at the 6-person table—all to the soft soundtrack of the turquoise waves. A beach walkover at the end offers access to the beach below. For restful nights, this level includes 2 guest bedrooms featuring king beds.On the third floor, 4 luxurious bedrooms await—3 primary bedrooms featuring a king and private bathroom, and 1 guest room with 2 upholstered queen beds, a private bathroom, and access to the third-floor balcony.Ascend to the fourth floor for a relaxing escape in the additional living area, featuring a cozy queen sleeper sofa, wet bar, and Gulf views. Down the hall is a guest bedroom featuring 1 twin bed, 3 full beds, 3 twin trundles, and a private bathroom.Experience the elegance and tranquility of a dream getaway right on the shore of Seagrove Beach at Sarayu. Parking for 7 vehicles, 8 complimentary adult bikes, and a 6-passenger low speed vehicle make it easy to explore. Book today!
